Death StormActive

Hidden ShadowPassiveExclusive Lv.1 · Lv.2
Holder deals 40% more Direct DMG to any target under [Bleed] status.
Blade of Corruption Lv.1Increases Leech Rate by 30% when Holder attacks enemies under [Bleed] status.

Blood DebtActiveExclusive Lv.3
Holder increases his ATK by 20% for 2 turns. Meanwhile, grants himself [Counterattack] for 3 turns. Afterwards, he gains 1 more action turn.
